_comment: ARX Omni exercise catalog. code = ExerciseSet.EXERCISE in DB. Mapping derived by joining the ARX cloud CSV export on date+max+intensity (68/68 matched). group per ARX Push/Pull/Drive. kind: compound | isolation.
_limiters: Optional per exercise. 'targets' = the muscles the exercise is FOR; 'limiters' = structures that tend to give out first although they are only a means (e.g. the grip on a Dead Lift). Several exercises sharing a limiter fatigue it cumulatively within a session, and an exercise whose TARGET is another exercise's LIMITER belongs after it in the plan. Vocabulary: grip, elbow_flexors (biceps/brachialis), triceps, shoulders (anterior deltoid), chest, lats, upper_back, lower_back, glutes, quads, hamstrings, calves. Missing fields are fine - the code treats them as empty.
